set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 2. Introduce pure ArchiveRevision and publication state, resource-backed OpenArchive, typed PayloadExecutor, structural versus content validation, and common receipt adaptation over current eager LNA-HDF5 and Zarr paths. Acceptance: valid unknown-representation archives remain inspectable; incomplete publication differs from unsupported representation; eager HDF5 reports WholePayload; Zarr retains exact request and byte evidence; success, failure, and cancellation close resources where supported; JVM and Scala.js portable gates pass.
set.title: RRA 2: split archive revision, resources, and typed payload execution
